title: Simmons Citrate Agar

references.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

purpose: Used specifically for the Citrate Utilization Test — supports growth only of organisms able to use citrate as their sole carbon source, and indicates that use with a color change.
targetOrganisms: Enterobacteriaceae being differentiated by citrate utilization

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

preparationSummary: Suspend the dehydrated powder per the manufacturer's stated concentration, heat to dissolve, dispense into tubes, and slant before sterilizing so the medium sets as a slant with a butt.

sterilization.value: commonly autoclaved at 121°C for 15 minutes for typical tube volumes

storage: Refrigerate prepared slants in sealed containers.
expectedAppearance: Green slant before inoculation (bromothymol blue at the medium's starting pH).
qualityControl: Confirm with known citrate-positive and citrate-negative reference organisms before relying on results.

reactions.reaction: Growth on the slant with a color change to Prussian/royal blue

manufacturerNotes: Citrate and indicator concentrations vary slightly between manufacturers — confirm against the specific product insert.
